page.layout: Single view of a closed book in vellum binding, front cover only. No printed text on the cover. Spine visible at left, with handwriting and a paper label on it.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The front cover is blank vellum with a dark ink or stain mark near the centre, not printed text. The spine carries handwritten ink fragments (not transcribed, since they are not printed) and a paper label with a shelf mark, which is excluded. Lighting and staining only.
